verdict.rationale: Stripe Issuing exposes a complete REST API for creating cards/cardholders, real-time authorization webhooks, and a documented test-simulation mode for pre-production automation, plus an official CLI (stripe-cli) — all consistent with headless/CI operation. Community evidence confirms real-world usage of the API for automated QA workflows. missing for 10: explicit CI/pipeline integration guides or SDK examples showing scripted deployment in CI systems.
